description:
About Bask Health
 Bask Health is a software platform that enables entrepreneurs, doctors, and healthcare businesses to launch, manage, and grow direct-to-consumer telehealth businesses.
 Our platform brings together patient experiences, clinical workflows, pharmacy operations, and commerce tools in one place.
 We're an entrepreneurial, product-focused engineering team that values ownership, technical excellence, and building software that solves real problems. Engineers work closely with product teams and company leadership, take features from idea to production, and have a direct role in shaping the platform.
 Engineering at Bask is AI-first and builder-led. We use tools like Cursor and Claude Code throughout development while maintaining high standards for reliability, testing, and software quality.
 About the Role
 We're looking for an early-career Software Engineer to join Bask Health's engineering team and help build, maintain, and improve the applications that power our telehealth platform.
 You'll contribute to real product features across merchant tools, patient experiences, internal systems, and backend services. Depending on the project, your work may involve frontend interfaces, backend development, APIs, databases, or integrations.
 This role is ideal for someone who has a foundation in software development and is ready to grow through hands-on engineering work. Whether your experience comes from internships, coursework, personal projects, or an initial engineering role, we're interested in your ability to learn, solve problems, and build reliable software.
 You'll collaborate with experienced engineers, product managers, and designers while receiving technical guidance and gradually taking on more ownership.
 We're looking for someone who takes initiative, asks thoughtful questions, cares about the quality of their work, and enjoys turning ideas into functional software.
 What You'll Do
 Build and maintain features across Bask's web applications.
 Develop frontend functionality using JavaScript, TypeScript, and React.
 Contribute to applications built with Next.js.
 Implement backend features and services using Node.js and TypeScript.
 Work with APIs to connect applications and backend systems.
 Contribute to merchant-facing and patient-facing product experiences.
 Help build internal tools and operational workflows.
 Work with SQL databases to retrieve and manage application data.
 Develop reusable frontend components and application functionality.
 Collaborate with engineers to understand requirements and technical approaches.
 Translate product specifications into working software.
 Assist with integrating third-party services and existing platform APIs.
 Investigate bugs and help troubleshoot production issues.
 Write readable, maintainable, and well-tested code.
 Participate in code reviews and incorporate technical feedback.
 Learn and apply engineering best practices for reliability and security.
 Contribute to application testing and quality assurance.
 Improve existing features based on product feedback and technical requirements.
 Help document implementation details and development processes.
 Participate in technical planning and engineering discussions.
 Collaborate with product managers and designers on feature development.
 Learn Bask's application architecture and deployment workflows.
 Use Git and collaborative development tools.
 Use AI-assisted development tools while understanding and validating generated code.
 Take increasing ownership of assigned engineering tasks and product features.
 Requirements 
 
 Foundational software engineering experience gained through coursework, internships, professional roles, freelance work, or personal projects.
 Understanding of core programming concepts and software development fundamentals.
 Familiarity with JavaScript or TypeScript.
 Experience building web applications or software projects.
 Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and modern web development.
 Familiarity with React or another frontend framework.
 Basic understanding of backend application development.
 Familiarity with APIs and how applications exchange data.
 Foundational knowledge of databases and data structures.
 Understanding of asynchronous programming concepts.
 Familiarity with Git and version control.
 Ability to read, understand, and modify existing code.
 Basic debugging and problem-solving skills.
 Willingness to learn automated testing and software quality practices.
 Ability to follow technical documentation and implementation guidance.
 Interest in building production software and improving existing applications.
 Strong attention to detail and code readability.
 Ability to communicate progress, challenges, and questions clearly.
 Willingness to collaborate with engineers and cross-functional teams.
 Openness to mentorship, feedback, and continuous learning.
 Ability to manage assigned tasks and take responsibility for deliverables.
 Comfort working in a remote engineering environment.
 Nice to Have
 Up to 2 years of professional software engineering experience.
 Previous software engineering internship experience.
 Personal or professional projects using React and Next.js.
 Experience with TypeScript.
 Familiarity with Node.js and backend JavaScript development.
 Experience working with SQL databases.
 Experience building or consuming REST APIs.
 Familiarity with automated testing frameworks.
 Exposure to AWS or another cloud platform.
 Familiarity with serverless application development.
 Experience using Prisma, Drizzle ORM, or similar database tools.
 Experience contributing to open-source projects.
 Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes.
 Experience building SaaS applications or internal tools.
 Interest in e-commerce, merchant platforms, or subscription software.
 Interest in healthcare or telehealth technology.
 Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor or Claude Code.
 A GitHub profile or portfolio demonstrating software development projects.
